title: Core Formation
summary: Elders of the Fighting Evil Sect, including Kun Sang, chase Wang Lin for a day and a night, and when their Great Elder arrives with more Core Formation cultivators he flees back to the cave. Li Muwan has waited three years for him, and she uses the Hundred Beast Spirit Furnace to refine a Tianli Pill from demonic blood vine while he tries to form his core. The Nine Li Corpse Bone Formation holds for three days before the elders break it. The Great Elder grabs Li Muwan to keep as a cultivation cauldron and tries to take the furnace, and she is ready to die rather than give him up. Wang Lin breaks through to Core Formation, kills a Core Formation elder in an instant and declares himself the strongest below Nascent Soul. The terrified Great Elder flees, and Wang Lin takes Li Muwan with him to hunt down the rest.

cultivation: Wang Lin breaks through to Core Formation and calls himself the strongest cultivator below Nascent Soul. One of the pursuing elders is at mid Core Formation.
